Summarize a group of fitted transition trees

Source: R/context_tree.R
summary.transitiontrees_group.Rd

summary() summarizes a transitiontrees_group with one row per group: the size of the data each tree was fitted on, the size and depth of the tree, and its in-sample fit (log-likelihood, number of parameters, AIC, BIC and perplexity, as returned by model_fit()). The in-sample fit describes each tree; to test whether the groups differ, use compare_groups().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees_group'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A transitiontrees_group object.

...

Not used.

Value

An object of class summary.transitiontrees_group, a data.frame with one row per group and columns group, n_seq, n_obs, n_nodes, max_depth, pruned, logLik, df, nobs, AIC, BIC and perplexity.

See also

context_tree(), model_fit(), compare_groups().

Examples

groups <- context_tree(group_regulation_long, actor = "Actor",
                       time = "Time", action = "Action",
                       group = "Achiever", max_depth = 2)
summary(groups)
#> <transitiontrees_group summary>  2 groups
#> 
#>  group n_seq n_obs n_nodes max_depth pruned logLik  df  nobs   AIC   BIC
#>   High  1000 13721      80         2  FALSE -22773 640 13721 46826 51643
#>    Low  1000 13812      82         2  FALSE -22968 656 13812 47248 52190
#>  perplexity
#>        5.26
#>        5.27
